headline: Tesla and Micron Shares Fall After Election Outcomes Impact AI and Tech Outlook
summary: Shares of Tesla, SpaceX, and Micron declined following recent election results in Texas and other states. Democratic victories have raised questions regarding the long-term outlook for artificial intelligence infrastructure buildouts.
why: Political shifts and potential congressional investigations can impact regulatory scrutiny and sentiment for high-growth technology and automotive companies.
